subject: Get list of entries from a specific clade of a phylogenetic tree (Newick file)?

messages.subject: Get list of entries from a specific clade of a phylogenetic tree (Newick file)?
parts:
Hi D-RUG,

I'm building phylogenetic trees from fasta files of Rubisco protein sequences. Once the tree is made (I've been using mafft --> fastTree --> Newick file --> iToL), I can see which Rubsico sequences are Form I, which are Form II, etc, based on their phylogenetic grouping; all form I Rubisco are in one clade, etc.

I want to be able to get the list of form I entries, and separately the list of Form II entries, etc.

Seems very simple but haven't gotten much headway from SO / BioStars forums / fastTree documentation.

Thanks for any suggestions you might have!

Best,
Rey
